passages.text: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn; Ashbel was the second born, Aharah the third, Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
passages.sermon:
Benjamin was a man from Israel.
Benjamin had five sons.
Bela was Benjamin’s first son.
Ashbel was Benjamin’s second son.
Aharah was Benjamin’s third son.
Nohah was Benjamin’s fourth son.
Rapha was Benjamin’s fifth son.
passages.original: וּבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הוֹלִ֖יד אֶת־ בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹר֑וֹ אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְאַחְרַ֖ח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃ נוֹחָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י וְרָפָ֖א הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Bela: Addar, Gera, Abihud, Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
passages.sermon: Bela was a descendant of Benjamin.\r\nBela had sons.\r\nTheir names were Addar, Gera, Abihud, Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃ וַאֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ וְנַעֲמָ֖ן וַאֲחֽוֹחַ׃ וְגֵרָ֥א וּשְׁפוּפָ֖ן וְחוּרָֽם׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
passages.sermon:
Ehud had descendants.
These descendants were leaders of families.
They lived in Geba.
They were exiled to Manahath.
Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera were among these descendants.
Gera led them into exile.
Gera was the father of Uzza.
Gera was also the father of Ahihud.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבוֹת֙ לְי֣וֹשְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַיַּגְל֖וּם אֶל־ מָנָֽחַת׃ וְנַעֲמָ֧ן וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה וְגֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑ם וְהוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עֻזָּ֖א וְאֶת־ אֲחִיחֻֽד׃

passages.text: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
passages.sermon:
Shaharaim was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
He had wives named Hushim and Baara.
Shaharaim divorced Hushim and Baara.
After this, Shaharaim went to the country of Moab.
Shaharaim had sons in Moab.
passages.original: וְשַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הוֹלִיד֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב מִן־ שִׁלְח֖וֹ אֹתָ֑ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְאֶֽת־ בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: His sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
passages.sermon:
Shaharaim had a wife named Hodesh.
Shaharaim had sons by Hodesh.
Their names were Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah.
These sons became heads of families.
passages.original: וַיּ֖וֹלֶד מִן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אֶת־ יוֹבָב֙ וְאֶת־ צִבְיָ֔א וְאֶת־ מֵישָׁ֖א וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּֽם׃ וְאֶת־ יְע֥וּץ וְאֶת־ שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖יו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
passages.sermon:
Shaharaim was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
He had a wife named Hushim.
Shaharaim had sons with Hushim.
Their names were Abitub and Elpaal.
passages.original: וּמֵחֻשִׁ֛ים הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲבִיט֖וּב וְאֶת־ אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages), and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families of the inhabitants of Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
passages.sermon:
Elpaal had several sons.
Their names were Eber, Misham, Shemed, Beriah, and Shema.
Shemed built the towns of Ono and Lod.
He also built the villages around them.
Beriah and Shema were leaders of families.
They led the people who lived in Aijalon.
Beriah and Shema drove out the people who lived in Gath.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּמִשְׁעָ֖ם וָשָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ אוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ לֹ֖ד וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וּבְרִעָ֣ה וָשֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּל֑וֹן הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת־ י֥וֹשְׁבֵי גַֽת׃

passages.text: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
passages.sermon:
Beriah was a man.
Beriah had sons.
His sons were Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth.
His sons were also Zebadiah, Arad, and Eder.
His sons were also Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
passages.original: וְאַחְי֥וֹ שָׁשָׁ֖ק וִירֵמֽוֹת׃ וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וַעֲרָ֖ד וָעָֽדֶר׃ וּמִיכָאֵ֧ל וְיִשְׁפָּ֛ה וְיוֹחָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י בְרִיעָֽה׃

passages.text: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
passages.sermon:
Elpaal was a man in the tribe of Benjamin.
He had several sons.
Zebadiah was a son of Elpaal.
Meshullam was a son of Elpaal.
Hizki was a son of Elpaal.
Heber was a son of Elpaal.
Ishmerai was a son of Elpaal.
Izliah was a son of Elpaal.
Jobab was a son of Elpaal.
passages.original: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם וְחִזְקִ֥י וָחָֽבֶר׃ וְיִשְׁמְרַ֧י וְיִזְלִיאָ֛ה וְיוֹבָ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
passages.sermon:
Shimei was the father of nine sons.
His sons were Jakim, Zichri, and Zabdi.
His sons also included Elienai, Zillethai, and Eliel.
His other sons were Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
passages.original: וְיָקִ֥ים וְזִכְרִ֖י וְזַבְדִּֽי׃ וֶאֱלִיעֵנַ֥י וְצִלְּתַ֖י וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃ וַעֲדָיָ֧ה וּבְרָאיָ֛ה וְשִׁמְרָ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י שִׁמְעִֽי׃

passages.text: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
passages.sermon:
Shashak was a man.
Shashak had sons.
His sons were Ishpan, Eber, and Eliel.
His sons also included Abdon, Zichri, and Hanan.
Hananiah, Elam, and Anthothijah were also his sons.
Iphdeiah and Penuel were sons of Shashak.
All these men were sons of Shashak.
passages.original: וְיִשְׁפָּ֥ן וָעֵ֖בֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃ וְעַבְדּ֥וֹן וְזִכְרִ֖י וְחָנָֽן׃ וַחֲנַנְיָ֥ה וְעֵילָ֖ם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּֽה׃ וְיִפְדְיָ֥ה וּפְנִיאֵל בְּנֵ֥י שָׁשָֽׁק׃

passages.text: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
passages.sermon:
Shamsherai was a son of Jeroham.
Shehariah was a son of Jeroham.
Athaliah was a son of Jeroham.
Jaareshiah was a son of Jeroham.
Elijah was a son of Jeroham.
Zichri was a son of Jeroham.
passages.original: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַ֥י וּשְׁחַרְיָ֖ה וַעֲתַלְיָֽה׃ וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָ֧ה וְאֵלִיָּ֛ה וְזִכְרִ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָֽם׃

passages.text: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon: These men were the heads of their families.\r\nThey were the leaders of their family lines.\r\nThey lived in Jerusalem.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֛וֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah, and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. These also lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Jeiel was the father of Gibeon.
Jeiel lived in Gibeon.
Jeiel’s wife was Maacah.
Jeiel’s firstborn son was Abdon.
Jeiel’s other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, and Mikloth.
Mikloth was the father of Shimeah.
These men lived in Jerusalem with their relatives.
passages.original: וּבְגִבְע֥וֹן יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃ וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֥וּר וְקִ֖ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנָדָֽב׃ וּגְד֥וֹר וְאַחְי֖וֹ וָזָֽכֶר׃ וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְאַף־ הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
passages.sermon:
Ner was the father of Kish.
Kish was the father of Saul.
Saul was the father of Jonathan.
Saul was the father of Malchishua.
Saul was the father of Abinadab.
Saul was the father of Esh-baal.
passages.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־ יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־ אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
passages.sermon: Jonathan was the father of Merib-baal.\r\nMerib-baal was the father of Micah.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מִיכָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
passages.sermon: Micah was a man in the family line of Saul.\r\nMicah had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַאְרֵ֥עַ וְאָחָֽז׃

passages.text: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
passages.sermon:
Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah.
Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth.
Jehoaddah was also the father of Azmaveth.
Jehoaddah was also the father of Zimri.
Zimri was the father of Moza.
passages.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יְהוֹעַדָּ֔ה וִיהֽוֹעַדָּ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־ עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מוֹצָֽא׃

passages.text: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
passages.sermon:
Moza was the father of Binea.
Binea was the father of Raphah.
Raphah was the father of Eleasah.
Eleasah was the father of Azel.
These men were descendants of Benjamin.
passages.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
passages.sermon:
Azel was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Azel had six sons.
Their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
All these men were sons of Azel.
passages.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃

passages.text: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
passages.sermon:
Eshek was Azel’s brother.
Eshek had sons.
Ulam was Eshek’s first son.
Jeush was Eshek’s second son.
Eliphelet was Eshek’s third son.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑יו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹר֔וֹ יְעוּשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וֶֽאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
Ulam had sons.
Ulam’s sons were mighty men of valor.
They were skilled archers.
They had many sons and grandsons.
Their total number was one hundred and fifty.
All these were descendants of Benjamin.
passages.original: וַֽיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־ א֠וּלָם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבֹּרֵי־ חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּמַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃פ
